-- First, check the current state of tasks
SELECT id, title, category, dueDate, `order`, completed FROM tasks WHERE category = 'work' ORDER BY dueDate, id LIMIT 10;

-- Update order values based on task ID and date
UPDATE tasks 
SET `order` = CASE 
  WHEN dueDate IS NOT NULL THEN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t2 
    WHERE t2.dueDate = tasks.dueDate 
    AND t2.id < tasks.id
  )
  ELSE 0
END
WHERE dueDate IS NOT NULL;

-- Verify the update
SELECT id, title, category, dueDate, `order`, completed FROM tasks WHERE category = 'work' ORDER BY dueDate, `order` LIMIT 10;
